title: Launch day
items: Player pages: stats by year (with college seasons for NFL players) and a Compare tool to chart up to four players side by side, by season or by career year.
Phones: game leaders now show the full stat line, including completions and touchdowns.

New look: a sleek monospace "terminal" design, a floating Weights button (bottom right) that opens the sliders, a Breakdown toggle for the factor columns, and a phone layout with the CFB/NFL switch on the right.
Box scores: head-to-head game leaders (passing, rushing, receiving, tackles, sacks) with headshots, one team on each side, plus Offense / Defense / Special Teams tabs for player stats.
Padding meter is now a smooth gradient bar that fills to each team's exact Padding score.
Box score pages got a broadcast-style scoreboard in each team's colors, and the win probability chart is shaded in team colors too.
"See it on the chart" from a team's panel now shows that team on the Schedules chart, zoomed in and highlighted, even if it's outside the top 25.
Box score pages reorganized into two columns, with highlights filling the space next to the win probability and team stats.
Tidier rankings rows: team name on top, with the Padding meter and badges lined up underneath.
Highlights on box score pages: official YouTube highlight videos play right on the page, plus ESPN's clips for college games.
Fix: the Compare tab, scores and standings now always use the Default ranking, and sorting by a column no longer overwrites your saved slider settings.
Schedules chart: pinch to zoom on phones, drag to pan, and zoom with +/−, double-click or Ctrl+scroll on computers.
Sharper look: redesigned Cupcake of the Week banner, and beveled, shadowed badges and tags.
Cleaner look: emoji replaced with broadcast-style badges (GAUNTLET, BARBELL, GRIND, CUPCAKE WALK), a segmented Padding meter, and the Cupcake Ref logo as the site icon.
Cupcake meter: up to five cupcakes under each college team's name show how padded its schedule is, no sorting needed.
AP Poll rank now shows next to each ranked team's name; Beaten Nobody and Over/Underrated tags only show on the overall ranking, not single-column sorts.
New Compare tab: our rankings side by side with the AP Poll, Coaches Poll, ESPN FPI and SP+, including where we disagree with everyone.
Every team now shows its best win, and top teams that haven't beaten a good team yet get a Beaten Nobody tag.
Release notes page (you're looking at it).
New slider presets: Best teams (weights re-learned every week from which blend best predicts the next week's winners) and Most deserving (record quality, schedule and cupcake padding).
Early-season rankings retuned: last year's results and roster talent now fade out by week 9, the setting that predicted games best in testing.
Phone fixes: tapping a search box or dropdown no longer zooms the page, team schedules fit the screen, and team panels scroll on their own.
Every FCS team now has its own rating, so beating a strong FCS team counts differently than beating a weak one.
Schedule profiles: every college team is labeled Gauntlet, Barbell, Honest Grind or Cupcake Walk, with a new Schedules chart.
Cupcake score is now relative: a cupcake is an opponent far below your level, so bad teams playing other bad teams isn't padding.
Cupcake of the Week: the team that beat up the most on the biggest cupcake.
Point differential column, and Record, AP and Diff columns are sortable.
Win probability chart: hover or drag to see the odds and the play at any moment.
Faster pages: team logos and player photos load at the size they're shown.
Live scores, box scores, player stats and game logs, standings, rosters and team pages.
NFL rankings, with starting-QB change warnings.
Next week's picks compared with the sportsbooks, with a running record.
College football power rankings built on schedule strength, efficiency and context, updated every Monday.
